title: Concept: Pack-time hook in the manifest
description: package.json declares a `prepack` script that runs while building the tarball, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `prepack` script that runs while building the tarball.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `prepack` script that runs while building the tarball.
